items.title: BSE IT index set to report 2nd sharpest monthly rally in over two decades
items.description: Thus far in the month of October, the BSE IT index rallied 14.4% while it surged 14.7% in July 2026. Earlier in July 2020, the IT index soared 22.6%, data shows.
